name: Action link workflow
description: Experimental State Action plugin that exposes a workflow's transitions as action links, one direction per transition (derived per workflow entity).
project_description: Experimental submodule of Action Link (requires core Workflows). Provides a 'workflow' State Action plugin whose directions are derived from a workflow entity's transitions, with one derivative plugin per workflow (WorkflowActionLinkDeriver). getDirections() lists the workflow transitions; getNextStateName() reads the entity's moderation_state and returns the target state of the requested transition. The plugin is incomplete: several methods (advanceState, buildConfigurationForm, message/access hooks) are stubs, and the entity route parameter type is hardcoded to node. Marked experimental.
